name: GTEA
notes: The official page describes seven daily activities performed by four subjects with a cap-mounted camera. Reported duration is less than two hours, so hours remain blank rather than converting an upper bound into an exact value.

name: EGTEA Gaze+
notes: The official page reports 28 de-identified hours, 86 sessions, and 32 subjects, with HD video, audio, gaze, action annotations, and sampled hand masks. Episodes stores sessions.

name: H2O
notes: The paper confirms synchronized multi-view RGB-D, two-hand pose, object pose, camera pose, and scene point clouds. Duration and participant count follow the official release metadata; no dataset license was identified.

name: Assembly101
notes: The paper reports 4,321 videos from four ego and eight static cameras. Video count is not entered as episodes; hours and participants follow the official project release.

name: EPIC-KITCHENS-100
notes: Release year follows the dataset release; IJCV article appeared in 2022. Hours, participants, and kitchens are reported values.

name: Ego4D
notes: The paper reports 931 participants; some later web material reports 923. ProjectEgo retains the paper value and flags the discrepancy.

name: HOI4D
notes: Sequence count and participant count are reported by the project; duration is a secondary-audit estimate and remains metadata-level.

name: ARCTIC
notes: The paper reports 2.1M frames with accurate 3D hand/object meshes and contact information. Duration and participant count follow official release metadata.

name: BridgeData V2
notes: Trajectory and environment counts are reported release metadata; hours remain blank because no reconciled value is used.

name: RH20T
notes: The paper reports over 110,000 contact-rich robot sequences with visual, force, audio, action, paired human video, and language. Hours remain blank; the arXiv article license is not treated as a dataset license.

name: DROID
notes: Official page cross-check: 76k trajectories, 350 hours, 564 scenes, 86 tasks, and 50 collectors. Environments stores reported scenes.

name: Ego-Exo4D
notes: The 1,286 hours combine synchronized ego and exo video; they are not unique wall-clock activity hours.

name: HOT3D
notes: Release year follows the initial paper and dataset announcement. Duration is approximately 833 minutes, rounded to 14.0 hours.

name: Nymeria
notes: The paper reports 300 hours, 264 participants, and 50 locations with synchronized multimodal ego devices and an external observer. Dataset terms are kept separate from the paper's arXiv license.

name: Open X-Embodiment
notes: One-million scale is an approximate collection-level headline. Component datasets retain their own licenses and schemas.

name: TACO
notes: The paper reports 2.5K motion sequences with paired third-person and egocentric views, 3D meshes, and action labels. No reconciled duration or dataset license is reported.

name: EgoDex
notes: Participant and environment counts are intentionally blank pending source reconciliation.

name: EgoLife
notes: The paper reports 300 hours from six participants living together for one week, with multimodal egocentric and synchronized third-person capture.

name: RoboMIND
notes: The RSS 2025 paper reports 107k trajectories across 479 tasks, 96 object classes, and four robot embodiments, including 5k failure demonstrations. Hours and dataset license remain unreconciled.

name: EgoVerse
notes: Living dataset. Values describe the paper release and require a new record when the release changes.
